title: Other country (outside the five markets): generic reportability questions, starter
plain: For a country outside the five built-in markets: Reportable when the event led to a death, a serious deterioration in health or a serious public health threat, or a malfunction could lead to death or serious deterioration were it to happen again. Generic starter questions, not this country's law: confirm with your consultant.
law_in_force_from: No country's law: generic starter (for your consultant to confirm)

change.reason: B9b (OC spec approved 9 Nov 2026; plan decision B9b-N1 approved 11 Nov 2026).

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B9b plan approved 11 Nov 2026 (N1: the generic Reportable rule, labelled a generic starter).

question_set.title: Other country: generic reportability questions (IMDRF/GHTF common criteria, starter)
question_set.note: One generic set for every country outside the five built-in markets. Generic starter questions, not this country's law: confirm with your consultant. The period comes from your reporting window naming the country, or the due date you enter on the report.

questions.text: Did the event lead to the death of a patient, user or other person?
questions.definition: A death the device caused or contributed to, or may have.

questions.text: Did it lead to a serious deterioration in the state of health of a patient, user or other person?
questions.definition: Serious deterioration in the state of health (generic starter wording): a life-threatening illness or injury, the permanent impairment of a body function or permanent damage to a body structure, or a condition that needs medical or surgical intervention to prevent them.

questions.text: Could it lead to death or a serious deterioration in the state of health, were it to happen again?
questions.definition: Serious deterioration in the state of health (generic starter wording): a life-threatening illness or injury, the permanent impairment of a body function or permanent damage to a body structure, or a condition that needs medical or surgical intervention to prevent them.

questions.text: Is it a serious public health threat?
questions.definition: An event that may lead to imminent risk of death, serious deterioration in health or serious illness for many people, and that may need prompt remedial action (generic starter wording).

questions.text: Was there a malfunction or deterioration in the characteristics or performance of the device (including its labelling or instructions for use)?
questions.definition: Any failure of the device to perform as intended, including an inadequacy in its labelling or instructions for use.
An act, or omission of an act, by the user that led to a different result than the manufacturer intended or the user expected. A note only: it never lowers the outcome.

questions.text: Is the device marketed (made available) in this country?
questions.definition: A note only: some authorities want a report even for a device not marketed there (for example in a clinical study). It never lowers the outcome.

OTHER_REPORT.label: Report to this country's authority (period: your reporting window naming the country, or the due date you enter)

notes.text: Generic starter questions, not this country's law: confirm with your consultant.
A use error was involved: some authorities ask for use-error reports too. Check with your consultant.
The device is not marketed in this country: some authorities still want a report. Check with your consultant.
An Unknown answer could make the event reportable: the suggestion stays pending information, and "not reportable" cannot be concluded until it is answered.

folding.why: Not needed: it led to a death
Not needed: no malfunction or deterioration of the device
